title: Innsmouth Shore

'''Innsmouth Shore''' is a [[neighborhood]] of [[Innsmouth]]. It first appeared in the [[Innsmouth Horror]] expansion. The Innsmouth Shore [[street]] area is an [[aquatic location]].

*[[Falcon Point]]
